session.combo: Select the active saved session. Sessions remember repository path, patch directory, UI state, selected files, and related workflow settings.
session.save_as: Save the current UI state under a new session name.
session.delete: Delete the current saved session. The default session cannot be deleted.
repo.path: Path to the git repository used by PackPatch UI.
repo.refresh: Refresh repository status, file list, packs, patch files, and commit history.
repo.status: Current git repository status: root, branch, and clean/dirty state.
pack.mode: Choose which working-tree files to include in the pack: selected files, changed files, full repository snapshot, or full snapshot with unversioned files.
pack.task: Pack name used in the generated archive filename. If empty, PackPatch UI uses the current repository directory name.
pack.create: Create a chatgpt-pack archive from the current repository using the selected pack mode.
pack.auto_export: Copy each newly created pack to the export directory automatically.
pack.include_sensitive: Include tracked keys and certificates that are normally excluded from packs (*.key, *.crt, *.pem, *.p12, *.pfx, *.cer). Untracked sensitive files remain excluded.
pack.export_dir: Directory where newly created packs are copied when auto export is enabled.
pack.list: Recently created chatgpt-pack archives in this repository. Drag is supported where the desktop allows it; double-click or use Show in Explorer for Windows-native drag and drop. The exported copy is preferred when available.
pack.copy_path: Copy the selected pack path to the clipboard.
pack.show_in_explorer: Open Windows Explorer and select the exported pack copy when available, otherwise the local pack archive. Double-clicking a pack does the same.
pack.delete: Delete selected pack archives after confirmation.
patch.dir: Directory containing patch files returned by ChatGPT, usually your Downloads folder.
patch.browse_dir: Choose the directory containing .patch or .diff files.
patch.target: Choose whether patch actions use the latest patch in the patch directory or exactly one selected patch from the list.
patch.apply_mode: Choose the patch apply strategy. The default tries Compatсh first with git am, then falls back to PackPatch with git apply.
patch.check: Run git apply --check for the target patch without changing the repository.
patch.dry_run: Run the apply script in dry-run mode for the target patch.
patch.apply: Apply the target patch with the selected apply mode. If Apply commit message is filled and PackPatch is used, the patch is applied and committed locally. Compatсh patches already carry their commit message.
patch.refresh_artifacts: Refresh the pack archive and patch file lists.
patch.list: Patch files found in the configured patch directory. Files may be PackPatch diffs or Compatсh format-patch files.
patch.copy_path: Copy the selected patch path to the clipboard.
patch.delete: Delete selected patch files after confirmation.
patch.preview: Read-only preview of the selected patch. Large patches are truncated for UI responsiveness.
commit.message: Optional commit message used only when applying a PackPatch via git apply. Compatсh patches carry their own commit message.
commit.list: Recent git commits from the selected repository.
commit.copy_hash: Copy the selected commit hash to the clipboard.
commit.undo: Undo the last local commit with git reset --mixed HEAD~1. Depending on Settings, resulting tracked and unversioned changes can then be stashed.
commit.stash_after_undo: After Undo last commit, stash all working tree changes with git stash push -u. Unversioned files are listed in the log before they are included. This setting is saved per session/repository workflow.
files.filter: Filter repository files by substring or directory prefix, for example main_window.py, tools/, or docs/.
files.select_changed: Select modified, staged, and untracked non-ignored files.
files.check_all: Select all files currently known to the repository file tree.
files.tree: Repository file tree. Check files or directories to include them in slice packs.
files.selection_count: Number of selected files that will be used by slice pack mode.
log: Execution log with commands, warnings, errors, and results. Important lines are colored by severity.
deploy.dir: Directory where the committed HEAD tree is deployed without untracked files.
deploy.browse_dir: Choose the deploy directory for the committed repository tree.
deploy.run: Deploy the committed HEAD tree into the deploy directory with rsync --delete, without copying untracked files.
deploy.auto_after_commit: Automatically deploy the committed HEAD tree after Apply patch creates a commit, including Compatсh patches applied with git am.
patch.allow_unversioned: Allow patch apply when the repository contains only unversioned, non-ignored files. Modified or staged tracked files still block apply. This setting is saved per session/repository workflow.
settings.open: Open per-session behavior settings for pack creation, patch apply, repository watching, and automatic deployment.
pack.auto_create_after_apply: Automatically run the existing Create pack flow after a patch applies new changes successfully. Dry-run and already-applied patches do not trigger pack creation. This setting is saved per session/repository workflow.
repo.watch_state: Watch the selected git repository at runtime and refresh branch, HEAD, clean/dirty status, repository files, and commit history when external git state changes. This setting is saved per session/repository workflow.
pack.include_unversioned: Include non-ignored unversioned files in created packs. Disabled by default because these files are usually local or temporary. The legacy full + untracked pack mode still includes them explicitly.
pack.history_depth: Number of real source git commits to preserve in every created pack. 0 uses a synthetic disposable base with no source history; default is 1. Larger values include more commit history and may expose older code, messages, or authorship data.
